care.formulaArchetype: Leave-on daily facial sunscreen SPF 50 PA+++ described by the manufacturer as ultra-light, hydrating and invisible, containing sodium hyaluronate, panthenol, glycerin and dimethicone with advanced photostable UV filters
care.advisoryBoundary: Supports everyday sun protection against UVA/UVB rays with a transparent finish. Reapply every 2-3 hours during extended sun exposure, heavy sweating, or swimming. Do not use as the sole sun protection measure — seek shade and wear protective clothing. Stop if irritation occurs and seek clinician advice for persistent skin concerns.

presentation.displayLine: Ultra-Light Hydrating Invisible Sunscreen SPF 50 PA+++ 50 g
presentation.usage: Cleanse your face thoroughly and complete your daily moisturizing routine. Apply generously 15-20 minutes before sun exposure. Gently smooth and blend using light, circular motions until fully absorbed. Reapply every 2-3 hours during extended sun exposure, heavy sweating, or swimming.
